title: Greek Stuffed Haricot Beans
description: A simple and flavorful vegetarian dish inspired by Greek cuisine. Haricot beans are stuffed with a delicious mixture of crispy onions, juicy tomatoes, and a hint of feta cheese.
instructions: Cook the haricot beans according to package instructions.
Chop the onions and sauté them in olive oil until crispy.
Chop the tomatoes and add them to the pan with the onions.
Crumb the feta cheese and add it to the pan.
Stuff each haricot bean with the onion and tomato mixture.
Place the stuffed beans on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
